rows: Look at a tribal NPC and press E
Type a message, then Enter. The NPC listens immediately; the model replies asynchronously. Enter opens another message while that person remains nearby.
Inspect the aimed, selected or nearest resident: actual activity/speed, health, breath/fatigue, normal routine, current plan and short fictional thought.
Inspect or disable the local model. Ordinary schedules continue independently. Settings live in the shared per-user NPC cache.

blocks.text: Verified: 17 Core mind assertions and 17 actual game checks: interaction, immediate listening, real replies, physical approach before speech, rest/resume, memory and owned-host cleanup. Another 120 identity/selection/save assertions include capitalization checks for twelve generated residents.

Current limit: replies are text in English translation. The small model can still invent incidental details; it cannot grant items or perform unsupported actions. Full-context CPU replies can be slow: the final native reply took 22.05 seconds. No new FPS claim is made.

pages.title: Small, bounded decisions
pages.subtitle: One shared local model; no world-wide NPC thinking loop.

images.caption: Actual debug panel cropped from the same game frame. ?Thought? is a generated character intention; actual activity is read from the live actor.

rows: Direct speech; nearby NPC address; injury; one observer noticing an unfamiliar visitor per community. Ordinary movement does not request inference.
One request in flight; queue of eight, with direct speech priority. Passive events have cooldowns. A visitor can trigger at most one background request per 20 seconds across nearby communities.
Actual identity, age, band, culture/language, known techniques, family links, current work/condition, nearby targets and short memories.
Approach, speak, wait, rest, flee or resume. Only supplied target identities are accepted. Existing navigation moves the actor; urgent group alarms override the model.
Up to twelve short records per encountered person, saved with local world state. Live action plans are temporary and expire back to the routine.
Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M, llama.cpp b12211. Two low-priority CPU threads, no GPU offload. Loaded only on the first event. A Windows job binds host lifetime to the game.

blocks.text: The 0.8B and 2B trials were rejected for confused speakers or unsupported details. Six structured 4B smoke cases returned valid decisions; the final packaged-game conversation was inspected separately. This remains a prototype dialogue model, not a complete NPC reasoning system.

Rebuild inputs: pinned model/runtime hashes and licenses in assets/npc-ai/runtime.json; setup-npc-ai.py installs the shared cache; check-npc-model.py repeats the CPU model cases. Full test receipts are in assets/verification/npc-minds-20261108.json.
